subject: Request to hold demo window while PO is under procurement review
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novamed.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial access nearing end — procurement validation in progress

Hi Olga,

Quick update from our side — procurement is doing a final validation on the PO (internal reference NM-7781). The legal and finance teams are asking for one more compliance item so routing will take another 5–7 business days.

We’ve been running integration tests and the team would lose momentum if the sandbox and demo project are turned off when the trial window closes tomorrow. Is there any way Redwood can briefly hold the demo open or extend the trial while we finish procurement? We don’t need anything fancy — just to keep the instance and API keys active so our engineers can finish the evaluation.

Appreciate any flexibility here. If it helps, I can share the PO preview.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Senior IT Procurement
NovaMed Health
elena.ruiz@novamed.com
attachments: PO_preview.pdf (attached)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novamed.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial access nearing end — procurement validation in progress

Thanks for the update, Elena — appreciate the heads up and the PO preview.

We can absolutely pause the trial timer to avoid losing your test state. To be transparent, our temporary holds are governed by a short interim agreement we ask customers to sign so we can track the extension and ensure security controls remain in place. I’ve attached the interim agreement for a quick e-signature: interim-trial-extension-agreement.pdf.

Proposed options:
- 5-day hold (standard): keeps the sandbox, API keys, and stored test artifacts intact; limited to non-production quotas.
- 10-day hold (extended): same as above but includes 2k trial credits to cover extra testing.

If procurement can confirm a PO number and expected clearance date, we’re happy to set the 10-day hold while you finish routing. If legal prefers, we can sign the interim agreement and log a brief note in the HubSpot deal record.

Camila, can you pre-authorize the 10-day hold once Elena confirms?

Olga
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

--
